description: The tools Frontier Desk publishes for owners, each with what a reader gets from running it, plus the written pages behind them. Pass a route from here to get_public_page for that page's framing as written. The hub renders at https://www.frontierdesk.ai/tools. Every tool on this page runs on what you already know about the company and answers in one sitting. None of them asks for a data room, and none of them is a form that goes somewhere to be read later.
name: list_public_pages
title: List the desk's public tool pages
